briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek-R2 escalate multi-agent capabilities amid rising compute arms race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate toward AGI with o4 and Claude 4 releases driving capability leaps. Global funding surges past $11B this quarter as governments prioritize AI infrastructure. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in deployed systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI ships o4 with advanced agentic reasoning; Anthropic releases Claude 4 Opus; Google unveils Gemini 3; Meta open-sources Llama 4 400B; xAI deploys Grok 3; DeepSeek-R2 matches o3 performance at lower cost. Multi-agent orchestration emerges as key differentiator.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: New jailbreak techniques bypass o4 guardrails in 34% of tests. Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level for multi-agent, automotive, and BCI use cases.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell ramp hits 1.2M units monthly; Microsoft breaks ground on $15B Texas supercluster; TSMC allocates 28nm capacity exclusively for AI accelerators through 2027.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will regulatory fragmentation slow the US-China AGI timeline by more than 18 months?
